description:
Pull requests, branch builds, and the release workflow execute one maintained definition of the full normal validation suite on their own commit.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The normal CI workflow accepts `workflow_call` while retaining its pull-request and branch behavior, without duplicating the Rust, web, MCP, repository-validation, or MSRV job definitions.
- [hard] REQ-02: The shared workflow-contract checks assert that a caller declares each required Rust, web, MCP, repository-validation, and exact-MSRV job as a `needs` predecessor, so no caller can reach success while one of them fails on the called commit.
- [hard] REQ-03: Existing CI workflow checks and representative local suite commands remain green after the trigger and refactor change.

## Notes

Blast radius: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and workflow-contract assertions only; security and publication stay in their dedicated workflows.
title: Make the normal validation suites reusable
